q: How many edges does a spanning tree of V nodes have?
why: Any tree on V nodes has V − 1 edges.

q: In Kruskal, when is an edge skipped?
options: When its endpoints are already in the same component
why: Adding it would create a cycle.

q: Prim's algorithm grows the tree by adding…
options: The cheapest edge with exactly one end in the tree
why: It always extends the single tree it's building.

q: 1000 points, every pair is a possible edge. Which version is simplest and fast?
options: O(V²) Prim with a distance array

q: MST vs shortest paths: which statement is true?
options: An MST minimises total edge weight; it doesn't guarantee the shortest path between two nodes
Shortest paths always form an MST
why: Different objectives: the cheapest network vs the cheapest route.
